description: Log-scaled graded sizing ladder from 0.1% to 16.0% price drops mapping to 1.0x to 8.0x multipliers. The selected first-allocation base amount is multiplied by the tier multiplier. No upper cutoff: any drop >= 16% is 8x.

base_amount_policy.dynamic_first_allocation_scale: Below the prior close AND the prior regular-session low -> $2.00; below the prior close only -> $1.00; not below the prior close -> no buy. A missing prior low is treated as not-below-low ($1.00). The ladder multiplier is applied after this base selection.
base_amount_policy.on_missing_or_unreadable_config: Use $2.00 (below close and low) or $1.00 (below close only) as hardcoded, user-confirmed fallbacks; never fall back to $50.00 or any broker/account default.

rescaled_2026_08_02: User-directed rescale. The prior curve stepped uniformly every 1% from 0.1% to 8% (0.1-1% 1x, 1-2% 1.5x, 2-3% 2x, 3-4% 2.5x, 4-5% 3x, 5-6% 3.5x, 6-7% 4x, 7-8% 4.5x, 8%+ 5x). This one is flatter on shallow dips -- 1x now runs to 2% and 1.5x to 4% -- and back-loads the scaling into deep drops, slicing 6-8% every half percent. Endpoints are unchanged (0x below 0.1%, 5x at 8%+), so the $10 max per order (5x * $2) and the $5 top of the reduced $1 scale are unchanged. KNOCK-ON EFFECT: config/budgets.json's high_multiplier_threshold counts 3x-or-greater signals for budget-tier selection, and 3x now requires a 6% drop rather than 4%, so tier escalation to Elevated/High-volatility/Stress is correspondingly less frequent for the same market conditions.
tier_boundary_rule: min inclusive, max exclusive; the largest tier threshold <= actual drop wins; drop < 0.1% = 0x (no buy).

requirements: Decision price is below the previous regular-session close.
signal_rules.note: A buy signal fires only when all three requirements hold together.

order_dollar_formula: order_dollar_amount_before_budget = selected_base_amount_usd * multiplier, where selected_base_amount_usd is $1.00 (below prior close only) or $2.00 (below prior close and prior low)
historical_note: Older ladder variants, including the 0.1%-to-12% sizing ladders, are HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED. This 0.1%-to-8%+ ladder (max 5x, no upper cutoff) is the current active ladder.
